warn_vigil.note: The first try at the crypt gate is stopped.

beats.text: The candles lean toward you, every one of them, as if you had said something, and the cold at the gate is the cold of a held breath.

the_voice.note: A voice at the top of the mountain, and then your shadow.

beats.text: There is nobody on the summit. There is only a voice, from everywhere, level and unhurried, and strangely familiar, like the voice of a man you have been told about and never met.
[[YELLOW]]A voice speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"You have come up carrying a sword that is hungry. I know it. I carried one."[[/]]

[[YELLOW]]A voice speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"The dark in you is not a flaw, my son. It is a choice you made each time you struck, each time you took the power it offered and paid for it in your own blood. You cannot cut it down. It must spend itself on you, and you must stand, and not strike back."[[/]]
The air in front of you thickens, and darkens, and takes the shape of someone in your armour with your blade in their hand, and when it lifts its head you see that it has your face.
[[YELLOW]]Your shadow speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"I am everything you did not want to be, and everything that kept you alive. Hold up your blade. Strike me, if you can."[[/]]

the_light.note: The shadow falls. The hero is made a paladin.

beats.text: It does not fall the way a thing falls. It has spent itself on you, blow by blow, until there is not enough left to hold the shape, and it comes apart in strips of grey that blow off the mountain. For a moment, before it goes, you see it smile.
[[YELLOW]]A voice speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"That is the hardest thing there is. You did not destroy it. You stood in front of it, and you did not turn away. Now put the sword down."[[/]]

You lay the dark blade on the white stone. It is lighter than it was. The armour comes off in your hands in pieces, and each piece, as it touches the stone, runs like water, and when the last of it is gone you are standing in a plain cloth tunic with nothing between you and the sky.

Where the dark blade lay, a white one is. When you lift it there is no weight in it at all, and then, all at once, there is, and it is exactly your own. You will want proper armour. The village below will have heard of this day before you do.
[[YELLOW]]A voice speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"There. Go down. Your friends are waiting, and there is a great deal for a paladin to do."[[/]]
The voice does not say goodbye. It is simply, gently, not there any more, and the whole sky is blue.

belaric_returns.note: Belaric steps out of a door in the mountain.

beats.text: A door you had taken for rock swings inward at the side of the path, and a tall, stooped old man in a soaked grey robe steps out of it, squinting at the daylight as if it had insulted him.
(talk belaric)

morvane_rises.note: The lord of earth in the Hall of Candles.

beats.text: The candles go out, all together, and in the dark something says your name in a voice like a shovel going into wet ground.
[[RED]]The floor of the hall heaves up into the shape of a man, and green fire opens where its eyes should be, and four small bone things come clicking up out of the dark behind it.[[/]]

bridge_ambush.note: Morvane takes you from behind on the bridge.

beats.text: You reach the far end of the bridge, and the stair is right there, and the daylight, and for a moment you think it is over. Behind you, something laughs.
[[RED]]It is the lord of earth again, and he has not troubled to be whole. He comes up out of the stone behind you with his arm still re-forming, and he has brought the cold with him.[[/]]
Morvane comes apart at last, bone and soil and a crown of root, and lies still across the black slab. The cold goes out of the air.

party_stops.note: Nobody can follow onto the mirror stair.

beats.text: [[YELLOW]]Tamsin speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Wait. I can't. The stair. I can't put my foot on it."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Tobin speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Me neither. It is like trying to walk into a wall made of looking."[[/]]
Neither can follow you onto the mirror stair, nor the old man behind them, whose jaw sets. They sit down on the bottom step together, as though they had been told to expect this.

morvane_breaks.note: The first form of Morvane is beaten; it is not over.

beats.text: Morvane comes down like a wall coming down: in one piece, and then in a great many. The green fire in his eyes goes out. The skullnants drop from the air one by one, clicking, and are quiet.
You stand a long time in the dark among the guttered candles, and nothing at all moves. It is the kind of silence that is only waiting.
